# LAMMPS input script for calculating elastic constants of Magnesium
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p
read_data magnesium.data

pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Mg_Zhou04.eam.alloy Mg

min_style cg
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

variable delta equal 1e-06
variable a equal "lx"
variable b equal "ly"
variable c equal "lz"

# Deformation loop
variable i loop 6
label loop

if "${i} == 1" then "change_box all x delta 0.0 remap units box"
if "${i} == 2" then "change_box all y delta 0.0 remap units box"
if "${i} == 3" then "change_box all z delta 0.0 remap units box"
if "${i} == 4" then "change_box all yz delta 0.0 remap units box"
if "${i} == 5" then "change_box all xz delta 0.0 remap units box"
if "${i} == 6" then "change_box all xy delta 0.0 remap units box"

minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Output stress tensor
variable sxx equal "-pxx"
variable syy equal "-pyy"
variable szz equal "-pzz"
variable syz equal "-pyz"
variable sxz equal "-pxz"
variable sxy equal "-pxy"

print "${sxx} ${syy} ${szz} ${syz} ${sxz} ${sxy}"

next i
goto loop

arguments.content:
# LAMMPS input script for calculating bulk modulus of Magnesium
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p
read_data magnesium.data

pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Mg_Zhou04.eam.alloy Mg

min_style cg
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Apply small finite deformations and calculate stress
# Deformation steps
variable step_size equal 1e-06

# Loop over deformation modes
label loop
variable i loop 6

# Apply deformation
if "${i} == 1" then "change_box all x scale ${step_size} remap units box"
if "${i} == 2" then "change_box all y scale ${step_size} remap units box"
if "${i} == 3" then "change_box all z scale ${step_size} remap units box"
if "${i} == 4" then "change_box all yz delta ${step_size} remap units box"
if "${i} == 5" then "change_box all xz delta ${step_size} remap units box"
if "${i} == 6" then "change_box all xy delta ${step_size} remap units box"

# Run minimization after deformation
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Calculate stress
compute stress all stress/atom NULL

# Next deformation mode
next i
jump SELF loop

# Output results
thermo_style custom step temp pe ke etotal press vol
thermo 100

arguments.content:
# LAMMPS input script for calculating elastic constants of copper
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p
read_data copper.data

pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Cu_Zhou04.eam.alloy Cu

min_style cg
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

variable delta equal 1e-06
variable a equal "lx"
variable b equal "ly"
variable c equal "lz"

# Deformation loop
variable i loop 6
label loop

if "${i} == 1" then "change_box all x delta 0.0 remap units box"
if "${i} == 2" then "change_box all y delta 0.0 remap units box"
if "${i} == 3" then "change_box all z delta 0.0 remap units box"
if "${i} == 4" then "change_box all yz delta 0.0 remap units box"
if "${i} == 5" then "change_box all xz delta 0.0 remap units box"
if "${i} == 6" then "change_box all xy delta 0.0 remap units box"

minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Output stress
variable sxx equal "-pxx"
variable syy equal "-pyy"
variable szz equal "-pzz"
variable syz equal "-pyz"
variable sxz equal "-pxz"
variable sxy equal "-pxy"

print "${sxx} ${syy} ${szz} ${syz} ${sxz} ${sxy}"

next i
goto loop

arguments.content:
# LAMMPS input script for calculating bulk modulus of copper
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p
read_data copper_structure.data

pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Cu_Zhou04.eam.alloy Cu

min_style cg
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Apply small finite deformations in each of the six independent strain modes
# Deformation step size and total deformation
variable step_size equal 1e-06
variable total_deformation equal -1 * (v_step_size * lattice_param)

# Loop over each strain mode
variable i loop 6
label loop_start

# Apply deformation
if "${i} == 1" then "displace_atoms all move v_total_deformation 0 0"
if "${i} == 2" then "displace_atoms all move 0 v_total_deformation 0"
if "${i} == 3" then "displace_atoms all move 0 0 v_total_deformation"
if "${i} == 4" then "displace_atoms all move 0 v_total_deformation v_total_deformation"
if "${i} == 5" then "displace_atoms all move v_total_deformation 0 v_total_deformation"
if "${i} == 6" then "displace_atoms all move v_total_deformation v_total_deformation 0"

# Run minimization
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Next strain mode
next i
goto loop_start

# Output stress-strain data
thermo_style custom step temp press pxx pyy pzz pyz pxz pxy
thermo 1

# End of script

# LAMMPS input script for calculating bulk modulus of Aluminum
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p
read_data Aluminum_structure.data

# Define interatomic potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Define minimization parameters
min_style cg
min_modify dmax 0.1 line quadratic

# Energy minimization
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Apply small deformations and calculate stress
variable delta equal 1e-06

# Loop over deformation modes
label loop
variable i loop 6

# Apply deformation
if "${i} == 1" then "change_box all x scale 1.0+v_delta y scale 1.0 z scale 1.0 remap units box"
if "${i} == 2" then "change_box all x scale 1.0 y scale 1.0+v_delta z scale 1.0 remap units box"
if "${i} == 3" then "change_box all x scale 1.0 y scale 1.0 z scale 1.0+v_delta remap units box"
if "${i} == 4" then "change_box all yz delta v_delta remap units box"
if "${i} == 5" then "change_box all xz delta v_delta remap units box"
if "${i} == 6" then "change_box all xy delta v_delta remap units box"

# Re-minimize after deformation
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Calculate stress
compute stress all stress/atom NULL
compute p all reduce sum c_stress[1] c_stress[2] c_stress[3]
variable pressure equal -(c_p[1]+c_p[2]+c_p[3])/(3*vol)

# Output stress
print "Deformation mode ${i}: Pressure = ${pressure} GPa"

# Next deformation mode
next i
goto loop

# End of script

# LAMMPS Input Script for Calculating Bulk Modulus of Aluminum

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

read_data /results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/comprehensive/tasks/aluminum_bulk_modulus_trial_3/Aluminum_structure.data

pair_style eam/alloy

min_style cg
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Apply small finite deformations and calculate stress
# Deformation steps
variable delta equal 1e-06

# Loop over deformation modes
label loop
variable i loop 6

# Apply deformation
if "${i} == 1" then "change_box all x scale 1.0+v_delta y scale 1.0 z scale 1.0 remap units box"
if "${i} == 2" then "change_box all x scale 1.0 y scale 1.0+v_delta z scale 1.0 remap units box"
if "${i} == 3" then "change_box all x scale 1.0 y scale 1.0 z scale 1.0+v_delta remap units box"

if "${i} == 5" then "change_box all xz delta v_delta remap units box"
if "${i} == 6" then "change_box all xy delta v_delta remap units box"

# Run minimization after deformation
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Calculate stress
compute stress all stress/atom NULL
compute p all reduce sum c_stress[1] c_stress[2] c_stress[3]

# Output stress
variable stressx equal c_p[1]
variable stressy equal c_p[2]
variable stressz equal c_p[3]
print "Stress after deformation ${i}: ${stressx} ${stressy} ${stressz}"

# Next deformation mode
next i
goto loop

# End of script

# LAMMPS input script for calculating bulk modulus of Silicon

units real
atom_style full
boundary p p p
read_data /results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/comprehensive/tasks/silicon_bulk_modulus_trial_3/Si.data

pair_style reaxff NULL
pair_coeff * * /potentials/REAXFF/ffield.reax Si

fix 1 all qeq/reaxff 1 0.0 10.0 1e-6 reaxff

min_style cg
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Define compute for stress
compute stress all stress/atom NULL
compute peratom all reduce sum c_stress[1] c_stress[2] c_stress[3] c_stress[4] c_stress[5] c_stress[6]

# Apply small finite deformations and calculate stress
# Deformation steps
variable step_size equal 1e-06

# Loop over deformation modes
variable i loop 6
label loop_start

# Apply deformation
if "${i} == 1" then "displace_atoms all move v_step_size 0 0"
if "${i} == 2" then "displace_atoms all move 0 v_step_size 0"
if "${i} == 3" then "displace_atoms all move 0 0 v_step_size"
if "${i} == 4" then "displace_atoms all move 0 v_step_size v_step_size"
if "${i} == 5" then "displace_atoms all move v_step_size 0 v_step_size"
if "${i} == 6" then "displace_atoms all move v_step_size v_step_size 0"

# Run minimization
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Output stress tensor components
thermo_style custom step temp press pe lx ly lz c_peratom[1] c_peratom[2] c_peratom[3] c_peratom[4] c_peratom[5] c_peratom[6]
thermo 1

# Next deformation mode
next i
jump SELF loop_start

# End of script
